evidence: Has the Validation label, edits CVerifyDB::VerifyDB in src/validation.cpp, and alters how chainstate verification handles missing undo data on pruned nodes.
rationale: Fixes false database corruption failures that abort node startup when pruned blocks have been refetched. By treating missing undo records as unavailable history rather than database corruption during deep verification checks, it prevents nodes from failing to restart and unblocks pruneassumevalid work.
